name: github-projects
description: Manage GitHub Projects v2 tasks inside Kiro Crew with dynamic Kanban and table views, instant column status updates, quick draft issue creation, and real-time filtering. Automatically detects your authenticated GitHub CLI owner or switches cleanly to any organization board.
author: pinho
highlights: Dynamic Kanban board and issue table view with instant switching
One-click status transitions, draft task creation, and safe deletion
Auto-detects the authenticated GitHub CLI user and switches between personal or organization projects
Includes the project-manager specialist agent and github-projects workflow skill
useCases: Triage and prioritize GitHub Projects v2 backlogs directly inside the Kiro Crew dashboard without switching browser tabs
Move cards across workflow stages or inspect all repository items side by side in compact multi-column or table layouts
Collaborate with the bundled project-manager agent and github-projects skill to break down requirements and update task status
configuration: Authenticate the GitHub CLI with the project scope (`gh auth login --scopes project` or `gh auth refresh -s project`)
Enable third-party app execution in `~/.kiro/crew/config.json` (`agent.apps_allow_third_party: true`) because this app runs a local Python backend

pt-BR.description: Quadro Kanban e gestão completa de tarefas para GitHub Projects v2 integrado ao Kiro Crew.
highlights: Quadro Kanban e Tabela com alternância instantânea e múltiplas colunas
Criação rápida de tasks, transição livre de status e exclusão em tempo real
Detecção automática do usuário autenticado no gh CLI e alternância entre projetos e organizações
Acompanha agente especialista project-manager e skill github-projects
